name: Northeastern University
description: Northeastern University is a private research university in Boston, Massachusetts, founded in 1898. It is known for its cooperative education (co-op) programme, in which students alternate study with full-time work placements.
whyIncluded: Northeastern University is among the 10 universities in the United States most chosen by international students (22,465 international students in 2024-25, second in the US, per IIE Open Doors), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering, BSME (Boston)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international undergraduates at Northeastern, same for all majors, plus the comprehensive fee. Rises most years; health insurance and housing fees not included.
programmes.notes: Student Financial Services tuition and fees page, Boston undergraduate: full-time tuition $35,525 per term x2 = $71,050 (2026-27); $33,995 x2 = $67,990 (2025-26, same page). Other fees 2026-27 = Comprehensive Fee $788 per semester (maximum $1,576 a year), which replaced the 2025-26 student activity ($180/yr), student center ($85/sem), recreation ($75/sem) and undergraduate student ($362.50/sem) fees = $1,225; 2025-26 also had a one-time International Student Fee $450, which the 2026-27 undergraduate table no longer lists. Residential Student Fee ($37/sem, campus residents only), course lab fees and the Student Health Plan ($3,049, waivable) excluded. Same tuition for all majors. Not cohort-locked. Four academic years of tuition; co-op periods (many students take 5 years) are not charged tuition. 2024-25 rates not found (prior-year page not published at the usual address). College of Engineering.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering, MSME (Boston)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for an international full-time master's student at Northeastern (charged per credit, about 16 credits a year), plus campus fees and a one-time international fee. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: College of Engineering rate $1,977 per credit hour (2026-27); $1,929 (2025-26). Graduate tuition is charged per credit hour. The programme needs 32 semester hours (catalog), taken here as 16 a year over 2 years, so annual = 16 x rate. Other fees 2026-27 = full-time master's Comprehensive Fee $200 per term (maximum $400 a year) + Health and Counseling Fee $225 a year; one-off = International Student Fee $450. Student health plan ($3,049, waivable) excluded. 2025-26 history row carries tuition only (the 2025-26 fee rows were itemised differently; current fees used). 2024-25 rates not found. Not cohort-locked.
